title: Calculator App PRD

overview.description: A clean, reliable, and intuitive calculator application for everyday arithmetic and scientific calculations.
goals: Provide a fast and accurate calculation experience
Support both basic and scientific calculation modes
Deliver a consistent, accessible UI across devices
successMetrics: Zero calculation errors in standard arithmetic operations
User task completion rate above 95% for basic operations

userPersonas.name: Everyday User
userPersonas.description: A person who needs quick arithmetic for daily tasks such as splitting bills, budgeting, or shopping.

userPersonas.name: Student
userPersonas.description: A secondary or tertiary student who needs scientific functions for coursework.

userPersonas.name: Professional
userPersonas.description: An office worker or tradesperson doing quick calculations on the go.

features.name: Basic Arithmetic
features.description: Support addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
acceptanceCriteria: User can input two or more numbers and an operator
Result is displayed immediately upon pressing equals
Division by zero displays a clear error message

features.name: Scientific Mode
features.description: Extend basic mode with scientific functions.
acceptanceCriteria: User can toggle between basic and scientific mode
Scientific mode includes: sin, cos, tan, log, ln, square root, exponentiation, pi, and factorial
All scientific functions return results accurate to at least 10 decimal places

features.name: Calculation History
features.description: Display a scrollable log of recent calculations within the session.
acceptanceCriteria: Last 20 calculations are displayed in a history panel
User can tap a history entry to restore it to the input field
History is cleared when the session ends

features.name: Copy Result
features.description: Allow the user to copy the current result to the clipboard.
acceptanceCriteria: A copy button or long-press gesture copies the displayed result
A confirmation toast or indicator appears after copying

features.name: Keyboard Support
features.description: Full physical and on-screen keyboard input support.
acceptanceCriteria: All numeric and operator keys map correctly to calculator functions
Enter key triggers equals
Backspace key deletes the last character

features.name: Accessibility
features.description: The app meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons have descriptive ARIA labels
Colour contrast ratio meets 4.5:1 minimum
Screen reader compatibility confirmed on iOS VoiceOver and Android TalkBack

features.name: Responsive Design
features.description: The UI adapts correctly to mobile, tablet, and desktop screen sizes.
acceptanceCriteria: Layout is usable at viewport widths from 320px to 1920px
Buttons are a minimum of 44x44px tap target on mobile

features.name: Dark Mode
features.description: Support a dark colour theme that follows the device system preference.
acceptanceCriteria: App detects and applies system dark/light mode automatically
User can manually override theme preference within the app

technicalConsiderations: Calculations must use a reliable math library to avoid floating-point precision errors
App must function fully offline with no network dependency
State should be preserved if the user navigates away and returns within the same session
assumptions: The app will be delivered as a web application, with mobile app wrappers considered in a future phase
No backend infrastructure is required for the initial release
openQuestions: Should calculation history persist across sessions (requires local storage or a backend)?
Is there a requirement to support a specific set of scientific functions beyond the standard set listed?
What is the target browser/OS support matrix?
